title: Arduino Uno · blinking LED
prompt: Blink an external red LED every second using an Arduino Uno R3

warnings: Terminal-strip geometry comes from person2 commit 9d81633. Power rail holes use a modeled symmetric layout, not measured hardware (rails 3 pitches outside A and J, 5-hole groups spanning rows 3-61), because the source rails were asymmetric; see UNITY_HANDOFF.md. Electrical strip connectivity and the button's 7.62 mm square footprint/pin pairing still need physical confirmation. The source dimensions do not agree with its hole extents; hole coordinates are authoritative for placement. Only LED asset metadata is supplied; other asset IDs require normalized Unity prefabs.
Uno R3 only: D13 drives one red LED through 220 ohm. Unity derives the Uno pose from its external mount plus measured pin anchors. Firmware has not been uploaded to physical hardware.

instructions.text: With power disconnected, place led (red): anode (+, long lead) → A15, cathode (−, short lead) → A16. The long lead is normally the anode; verify the flat side/short lead is the cathode.
With power disconnected, place resistor (220ohm): lead A → B12, lead B → B15.
With power disconnected, connect the red jumper from I1 to C12.
With power disconnected, connect the black jumper from C16 to I2.
With USB disconnected, connect Uno D13 → I1, GND → I2. Check wiring, then connect USB and upload circuit.ino.

firmware.uploadInstructions: Select Arduino Uno and its USB port in Arduino IDE. Wire with USB disconnected; check polarity, then connect USB and upload circuit.ino. No separate 5 V supply is used.
